messages:
jamie-sales: Heads up — BetaBank POC just sent a report: intermittent 429s during an embeddings-heavy demo. They say console quota looks normal. Can someone triage?
ana-support: Can you get a failing response body or headers + a request_id? Also which model and endpoint?
jamie-sales: Endpoint: POST /v1/embeddings (rwd-embed-xl). Example req_id: rb_6f4b2a. Occurred around 11:03 ET. They see a few 429s clustered for ~45s.
david-eng: Likely burst-shedding on a per-route window. Do we know if they batch multiple vectors per HTTP call or spin up parallel workers?
jamie-sales: Customer says they run 10 worker threads and do batch size 8. Their dashboard shows spikes at roughly 1k reqs/min during the demo.
ana-support: Asking for the raw headers. Also requesting whether their API key is shared across hosts.
ops-bot: Tenant quota snapshot for betabank-tenant: total_daily_tokens=54,200, route_requests_window=300 req/min, per_route_tokens_window=2,400 tokens/min, current_window_tokens=2,760 -> over limit. Auto-shed engaged.
sunita-se: That bot snapshot confirms window overrun. Important: our route_requests_window is in requests/min but embeddings token window is tokens/min. With batch 8 and 10 workers their effective token/sec is higher than they assume.
david-eng: Quick check: rb_6f4b2a log line: {req_id: rb_6f4b2a, endpoint: embeddings.create, tokens: 96, status: 429, reason: route_token_window_exceeded, ts: 2333200183}
nana-support: Customer also pasted client HTTP headers: \n```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rw-route-cap: 300
x-rw-route-cap-remaining: 0
x-rw-token-window-reset: 18
```
jamie-sales: They claim they didn't change concurrency for the demo vs. yesterday. Could there be a change in our metering?
sunita-se: We rolled out a tokenization fix last week that slightly changed token counts for some unicode sequences. That could push them just over the threshold. I'll check change logs.
david-eng: Short mitigation options: 1) temporarily raise the route soft cap for this tenant, 2) enable temporary smoothing that adds a tiny per-request delay on our side, 3) ask customer to reduce worker concurrency. For a demo now, (1) is fastest.
nana-support: I've requested approval from account exec to do a 2x soft bump for 45 minutes. Also asked customer to throttle to 5 workers as a fallback.
ops-bot: Admin action pending: route soft cap increase request queued for review.
jamie-sales: Customer says they cannot modify their client quickly. Please prioritize.
sunita-se: Approving a one-time bump to 600 req/min (expires in 45m) with a safeguard: if tenant tokens exceed 4,000 tokens/min we'll auto-revoke and alert. Applying now.
ops-bot: Action: route soft cap increased to 600 req/min for tenant betabank-tenant. Expiry: 2700s. Notification sent to billing and security channels.
jamie-sales: Customer tested — 429s faded after ~70s. They ran through the rest of the demo.
david-eng: Post-demo follow-ups: 1) document effects of last week's tokenizer change and share recommended batch sizes; 2) add a per-key concurrency advisory note in docs; 3) consider an opt-in demo-mode that temporarily raises caps for short windows with billing acknowledgment.
sunita-se: I'll draft the customer-facing note and offer a short technical session to explain tokenization and batching.
nana-support: I'll file a support ticket with collected logs (rb_6f4b2a, rb_6f4b2b, rb_6f4b2c) and the change history of the soft cap. Assigning to sunita-se.
jamie-sales: Fantastic, thanks all. Closing this swarm. :party_popper:)
